Card Q&A.q: Does this card's [Your Turn] effect trigger when this card is in the breeding area and would digivolve into a Digimon card with [Veedramon] in its name?

Effect: [Your Turn] When this Digimon would digivolve into a Digimon card with [Veedramon] in its name, reduce the digivolution cost by 1.
Inherited Effect: [All Turns] [Once Per Turn] When this Digimon with [Veedramon] in its name would leave the battle area by your opponent's effects, by suspending this Digimon, it doesn't leave.
